escenas.texto: One owl. One beach. One game the whole region can't stop talking about. This week in Oceania, three lists fought for your attention, and the winners are not who you'd expect. A tiny channel with just a few thousand subscribers went head to head with giants of over twenty million. Who came out on top? Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Oceania edition. Today we count down the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay with us until the very end, because number one in each list is a story of its own.

Quick rules before we start. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Oceania. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes straight from the official YouTube API, and the weekly cut is every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Ready? Let's go.

First list: the ten most viewed. Opening the countdown at number ten, W.O Kpop, with a twelve-second Short about an awards moment. Over two million views in its first week. Not bad for twelve seconds.

Number nine, from New Zealand, dmxruser, with “One simple trick”. Over two million views, and here's the surprise: this channel has only about fifteen thousand subscribers. Fifteen seconds of video, playing in the big leagues.

Number eight, from Australia, TGG, and this one goes the other way: one full hour of GTA 6 free-roam gameplay. Over sixty-seven minutes long, over two point one million views and over two thousand comments. Remember that game. You'll hear it again today.

Number seven, from New Zealand, Drama Investigator. Eight seconds. That's all it took. A Short about hitting a car instead of running into your crush, with over two point eight million views. A channel of about one hundred and fifty thousand subscribers, punching way above its weight.

Number six, from New Zealand, Amit Sharma, with a twenty-nine second Short about keeping Jensen home and an NVIDIA GPU giveaway. Over three point two million views, from a channel of about sixteen thousand subscribers. The climb is getting steeper.

Number five, and this might be the biggest underdog of the week. Step Bloom, a channel with about one thousand, one hundred subscribers, with a twelve-second bumper ball Short. Over three point four million views. One thousand subscribers, three million views. Let that sink in.

Number four, Bloxy Productions, with “Why You Exist.”. Over three point seven million views, and the best engagement on this list: about five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. Keep an eye on this one. It's not done with us today.

And now, the podium. The bronze medal goes to a channel with only about four thousand, two hundred subscribers. Owls in Towels, with “How to Wrap an Owl”. Fifteen seconds, and over three point nine million views. Yes. An owl, in a towel, on the podium.

Silver medal, from Australia, CrackerMilk, with “Swimming between the flags”. Over seven point four million views, and the fastest-growing video on the list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. It almost doubled third place. But there is one video above it.

Drum roll, please. The most viewed video of the week in Oceania comes from Australia. LazarBeam, with “Testing Everything In GTA 6”. Over eight point five million views and over one thousand comments. The game everyone is talking about takes the crown.

Second list: the conversation. These are the ten most commented videos. At number ten, emma & georgia, with “So excited omg!!”. Over one thousand comments, in just one day. And the best engagement on this list: about six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

Number nine, from Australia, Karl Jobst, with a deep dive into a cheating scandal in Black Ops 3 Zombies. Over one thousand comments in just two days, and over one million views. Scandal always gets people talking.
Number eight, from Australia, CrackerMilk again, our silver medal in views. “Swimming between the flags” also starts a conversation: over one thousand comments.
Number seven, from Australia, LazarBeam, the king of views, with “Testing Everything In GTA 6”. Over one thousand comments. Big in views, but in this list, others talk louder.
Number six, from Australia, TGG and its hour of GTA 6 free-roam gameplay. Over two thousand comments. A video over sixty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to discuss it.
Number five, from Australia, Lessons in Meme Culture, with “GTA 6 Has Become A Meme”. Over two thousand comments and over eight hundred and eighty-four thousand views. Notice a pattern?
Number four, from New Zealand, RadicalSoda, with a Five Nights at Freddy's quiz over seventy minutes long. Over two thousand comments and over one million views. Long videos, loyal fans.
Podium time. Bronze medal, from Australia, SAMTIME, with “People Aren’t Happy About GTA 6”. Over three thousand comments. Fans have opinions, and they're writing them down.

Silver medal, and look who's back. Owls in Towels, with “How to Wrap an Owl”. Over three thousand comments. A channel of four thousand subscribers, on the podium of two lists. But it's not number one here.

And here it is. The most commented video of the week in Oceania comes from New Zealand. Dolan Darkest, with “Is GTA 6 Completely Cooked”. Over four thousand comments, with over six hundred and eighty-four thousand views. Fewer views than many on this list, but the loudest conversation of all.
And the last list: the love. The ten most liked videos. At number ten, emma & georgia again, with “So excited omg!!”. Over forty-seven thousand likes in just one day.
Number nine, Gerard Briones, with “Is this normal?”, a forty-seven second comedy Short. Over fifty-two thousand likes, from a channel of about three thousand subscribers.
Number eight, from New Zealand, dmxruser, with “One simple trick”. Over fifty-five thousand likes. Fifteen seconds, two lists.
Number seven, from New Zealand, Drama Investigator and that eight-second car Short. Over fifty-six thousand likes.
Number six, Zack D. Films, with a twenty-eight second Short on how electricity reveals hidden fingerprints. Over sixty-four thousand likes, in just one day.

Number five, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “Enemies in Red Dead 2 be like”. Over eighty-four thousand likes and over one point two million views, with the best engagement of this list: about seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.
Number four, and the owl is back for a third list. Owls in Towels, with over one hundred and ten thousand likes. Fifteen seconds that won Oceania's heart.
The final podium. Bronze medal, from Australia, LazarBeam, with “Testing Everything In GTA 6”. Over one hundred and sixteen thousand likes.
Silver medal, from Australia, CrackerMilk, with “Swimming between the flags”. Over one hundred and twenty thousand likes. Second in views, second in likes. So who beat it?

Drum roll, please. The most liked video of the week in Oceania is Bloxy Productions, with “Why You Exist.”. Over one hundred and seventy-seven thousand likes, from over three point seven million views. Fourth in views, but number one in love.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Asia. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Oceania every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
